title: Development and validation of a cumulative risk model and assessment tool for radiation-induced hypothyroidism in head and neck cancer: a multicentre study

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Development and validation of a cumulative risk model and assessment tool for radiation-induced hypothyroidism in head and neck cancer: a multicentre study》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Materials & methods · abstract-2-1】This retrospective multicentre study included 1407 patients across four cohorts. The model was developed in the training cohort and externally validated in three independent cohorts. Candidate predictors included CT radiomics, dosiomics, dose-volume histogram parameters, and clinical variables. A multimodal Cox model was developed and used to estimate cumulative risks across time horizons. Temporal risk groups were derived from predicted 3- and 7-year risks.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Development and validation of a cumulative risk model and assessment tool for radiation-induced hypothyroidism in head and neck cancer: a multicentre study》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Results · abstract-3-1】A total of 1407 patients (mean age, 55.4 ± 13.8 years; 1027 men) were evaluated and RIHT occurred in 694 (49.3%). The final model integrated three CT radiomics features, four dosiomics features, mean thyroid dose, age and N stage. It achieved C-index/overall AUC values of 0.714/0.765 in the development cohort and 0.725/0.800, 0.680/0.754, and 0.627/0.690 in the three external validation cohorts. Four temporal risk groups had RIHT event rates of 21.7%, 46.1%, 58.3%, and 71.8%, with significant differences in RIHT-free survival (log-rank p < 0.001). The model was packaged as an open-source software tool for individualised risk assessment.

【Conclusion · abstract-4-1】The externally validated multimodal Cox model provided time-resolved, patient-specific RIHT risk estimates and temporal risk stratification using routinely available radiotherapy-planning data.
